initial_scene: Front three-quarter view of a seated humanoid facing the table. A single dark soft rectangular travel bag with a top handle and tan patch is on the table in front of it. Both hands initially rest near the lap, clear of the bag.

observed_sequence.action: Robot and bag remain at rest; both hands are near the lap.
Both open hands rise and extend forward above the bag.
Right hand descends toward the top beside the handle, left hand toward the top near the tan patch; exact first contacts are partly occluded.
Both hands descend on their respective top areas while the bag visibly collapses downward against the tabletop.
Both hands remain against the low top surface while the bag is flattened.
Right hand starts withdrawing slightly ahead of left; both rise and the bag visibly rebounds.
Both hands retract to lap; bag remains on table in a fuller shape.

arm_hand_roles.right: Anatomical right, darker hand attached to image-left shoulder: downward compression on top beside the handle, then withdrawal slightly ahead of left. No handle grasp, object lift, or transport is demonstrated.
arm_hand_roles.left: Anatomical left, white hand attached to image-right shoulder: downward compression on the top near the tan patch, synchronized with right. It withdraws just behind right; mere lower proximity during withdrawal is not treated as continued stabilizing pressure.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Both compress separate areas of the same deformable top against tabletop support. Hand/finger orientations follow the collapsing surface; no distinct release-and-regrasp, side squeeze, object transfer, or mechanism actuation is visible. Both ultimately lift clear.

anatomical_side_evidence.evidence: The initial PNG shows the robot’s face and frontal torso facing toward the table/camera. Each arm is continuously visible from shoulder to hand. The white hand follows the arm attached to the shoulder on image right, establishing anatomical left; the darker hand follows the shoulder on image left, establishing anatomical right. This attachment convention remains traceable through the raised, pressing, and final poses.

terminal_state: Robot remains seated with both hands returned near its lap. The bag stays on the tabletop and has rebounded substantially from its flattened pressed state; no lasting compact storage arrangement or relocation is visible.
uncertainties: Exact first and last contact frames for individual fingertips and each hand’s palm-versus-fingertip pressure distribution are hidden by the oblique view and dark material. Intervals describe visible engagement/deformation and separation rather than inferred force onset.
The left hand remains lower than the right during initial withdrawal, but continuing stabilizing pressure cannot be established from proximity alone.
Any lasting size reduction is not measurable. Visible temporary flattening and subsequent rebound do not establish permanent compression or successful storage.
annotation_discrepancies: The source instruction frames compression as reducing size for storage. Downward compression is visible, but the bag rebounds after release and is not stored in the clip; no permanent size reduction is asserted.
selected_execution_status_rationale: Completed visible two-hand pressing and withdrawal, with temporary bag flattening. This status is scoped to the visible manipulation and does not claim permanent size reduction or storage.
world_model_prompt: The humanoid robot brings its right hand onto the soft travel bag’s top beside the handle and its left hand onto the top near the tan patch. Both hands press downward together, flattening the bag against the tabletop. It lifts the right hand slightly ahead of the left and returns both hands toward its lap, leaving the bag on the table as it rebounds to a fuller shape. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
original_task_instruction: Pressing a soft travel bag to reduce its size for storage, requiring compression techniques and understanding of soft material behavior.

selected_segment.reason: Complete original single-task reference; no cropping or trimming requested.
